turns.content: For the gene order V-CT-CV, take r(V-CT)=13.2%, r(CT-CV)=6.4%, and the observed outer-marker value r(V-CV)=18.5%. Identify the middle marker and the two outer markers.
Add the two adjacent-interval percentages and compare their sum with the third reported percentage, keeping the stated marker labels.
Explain the discrepancy between that sum and the third percentage using the interpretation applied to these measurements.
Using that interpretation, determine the numerical consequence of the discrepancy and justify the calculation.
Summarize the interpretation and explain how it accounts for the three reported map quantities.
